endpoint: administratively coded dyslipidemia incidence, not necessarily high LDL
limitation: Outcome is dyslipidemia ICD E78 (not specifically high LDL or confirmed hypercholesterolemia); administrative diagnostic code limitations.

limitation: Not a lactase genotype study or lactose-intolerance outcome trial; Brazilian regulatory context 2018 could be outdated.

study_population: Narrative review by Chile-affiliated authors; no original recruited cohort
endpoint: narrative overview of celiac disease, not new prevalence cohort
limitation: Historical 2016 overview, not original Chilean patient prevalence or current diagnostic guideline; clinical assertions require updating.

study_population: Hospitalized adults at 87 Spanish hospitals in 2008-2010; comorbidity comparison
endpoint: hospital stay cost and mortality with celiac/alcohol diagnoses
limitation: Historical administrative cohort, selection and confounding limitations; hospital outcomes do not give individual ancestry-based risk.

study_population: Narrative scientific review; no newly recruited Brazilian patient cohort
endpoint: historical narrative review of hereditary hemochromatosis
limitation: Historic genotype/population generalizations in review require separate modern appraisal; no ancestry claims imported. Correct chronology: journal issue dated 2010, accepted 2009, placed in SciELO collection 2012.

study_population: Sociedade Brasileira de Cardiologia guideline for Brazilian clinical context; not one original participant sample
endpoint: society dyslipidemia guideline, no single trial endpoint
limitation: Issued guideline, not directly validated recommendation for this educational project; evidence strength and jurisdiction must be independently reviewed.

study_population: Fasa rural cohort source; 10103 adults ages 35-70, cross-sectional analysis
endpoint: anthropometry and prevalent type2 diabetes in Fasa cohort sample
limitation: Issue date is Iranian solar Hijri 1404; Gregorian year not asserted until publication-date reconciliation. Magiran record does not DISPLAY a DOI; this is not proof none exists. Cutoffs, sampling and external validity must be appraised independently.

study_population: 169 diabetes clinic attendees at CNLD Bamako; hypertensive diabetic subgroup of 75; three-month study
endpoint: hypertension recorded among type2 diabetes clinic attendees
limitation: PDF issue December 2021; HTML posted 2023-01-04 and citation_date 2021. Own DOI absent from HTML metadata/first-page citation; DOIs in references belong to other papers, not this article. No proof a DOI cannot exist elsewhere. Single clinic sample; definitions, selection and confounding unappraised.

study_population: 36 haemodialysis patients at Nouakchott Military Hospital, January–June 2018
endpoint: cardiac complications and comorbidity in dialysis case series
limitation: Publisher labels this a letter to the editor, although abstract reports a descriptive retroprospective study. Hypertension is a recorded comorbidity; dialysis sample is not national hypertension prevalence. DOI assignment chronology not inferred from article year. Full science unappraised.

limitation: Edition 2024 published 2025-01-20 in 17(1); primary issue contents and society release verify metadata. Full article route returned Page Not Found/paywall template, not verified full-text access. No treatment content, effect estimates or Chinese ancestry rules imported.
